limits: Exact raw duplicate case/title/status maps are compared; no normalization beyond deterministic ordering.
Framework installed bytes are producer-observed source fingerprint/hash receipt, not offline copies of full installed chunk or sampled worker binary identity.
Ancestry census is the declared coordinator sampler; no stronger complete worker/process-tree scope is invented.
Case/correctness durations include observer/setup/collection effects and are not timing or capacity evidence.
Every first failure and missing attempt remains visible; no retry/collector-only qualification from a failed run.
